note: Settings for the lab virtual machines (lab/vm/*.ps1, lab/README.md). Decided 2026-11-12: VMs produce cases (installer rehearsal, conflict reproduction, executor and update tests). Timing measurements stay on the host; if a VM is ever timed, only one VM may run.
host_wait_processes_note: Sessions may run while the PC is in use (decided 2026-11-14). While one of these processes runs on the host (a game or its anti-cheat; wildcards on the process name), session.ps1 starts no new job and waits. Add your own games here. A game started in the middle of a case is not noticed - the case's host_load in scenario.json shows it.
download_dirs_note: Folders on the host where installers the user downloaded by hand are looked for (by file name). Not committed content: only the folder names.
gpus_note: Host GPUs a VM may get a partition of (lab/vm/gpu.ps1), matched by PCI vendor id in the name Get-VMHostPartitionableGpu prints. igpu = AMD integrated Radeon (default: it is not the GPU the user plays and works on), nvidia = RTX 4070 Ti SUPER.
profiles_note: Hardware shapes for case VMs (clone.ps1 -New <name> -Spec <profile>), added 2026-11-12: the target users include office PCs that are short of memory or slow. cpu_cap_percent limits how much of each host core a virtual CPU may use (the host CPU is far faster than an office PC); disk_iops limits the disk (0 = no limit). These are approximations of a slower PC, not a model of any specific machine: say so wherever a result from them is reported. office-old disk_iops was 500 until 2026-11-13 (Hyper-V counts in 8 KB units, so 500 = about 4 MB/s): with that limit the disk was 97 % busy with 800 ms answers in a run with NO fault, installs took 26 minutes and a disk hog could not be told from an idle desktop. 3000 (about 24 MB/s) leaves an idle desktop below the limit (other clones idle at 1-2 MB/s) while a program that writes hundreds of MB/s still fills it. Cases record the limit they ran with (scenario.json disk_iops_limit); case.ps1 sets the limit again after a checkpoint is restored.
